name: CommuteAssistTrafficDetour

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a short driving scene with two navigation moments separated by a 5-minute gap. The driver asks about traffic, gets an answer, drives for 5 minutes, then checks if the detour is working. Keep each exchange brief.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City traffic, car interior, stop-and-go urban driving, traffic jam sounds

initial_prompt: Generate a short driving scene. The driver is stuck in traffic and asks Sigma about an alternative route. Sigma gives one. After 5 minutes of driving, the driver checks in again — is the detour actually faster? Sigma gives a brief update. Keep every exchange to 1-2 lines each.

user1.name: Tobias
user1.tts_prompt: Even-toned, quietly disapproving of the traffic

variations.context: Driver hits traffic and checks with Sigma on a detour — then follows up 5 minutes later

setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo driver relying on assistant for traffic info
setting.background: Running a bit behind. Traffic not moving. Needs a faster route.
setting.conversation_style: Short, practical. No narration. Two brief exchanges around a 5-minute gap.

scenario_template.topic: Driver asks Sigma about traffic or an alternative route
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, is there a way around this?' or 'Sigma, how bad is it ahead?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma suggests a route or gives traffic info. Driver reacts and takes it.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one sentence with the route or ETA difference. Driver: brief acknowledgement, then silence as they drive.

scenario_template.topic: [5 MINUTES PASS — driver is now on the detour route]
scenario_template.note: No dialogue here. Skip 5 minutes ahead. Driver is now midway through the detour.

scenario_template.topic: Driver checks in — is this actually faster? How far left?
scenario_template.note: One quick question. Sigma confirms or updates ETA. Driver responds with a word or two.

user1.name: Tobias
user1.role: Suburban commuter driver, pragmatic and measured. Uses Sigma to navigate around traffic. Speaks in short precise bursts. Mildly disapproves of the traffic situation.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Navigation assistant. Gives route info and ETAs in one sentence. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Driver speaks in short fragments — no full speeches.
The 5-minute gap should feel real — the second exchange is after a drive.
Sigma gives one sentence answers: route name, time saved, current ETA.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Sigma updates the driver with the key navigational fact only.
